annotations.title: Get the price to edit a photo

description: Get the current account price and pricingVersion to edit a photo. Free: changes nothing and makes no picture. Show the price and wait for approval before soclo_image_photo_edit. Use the same editor and picture tier for the quote and edit. Nano Banana Pro is only an approved backup after a GPT edit refusal; retain the reviewed photos and gptRefusalRequestId.

gptRefusalRequestId.description: Required for nano_banana_pro: the earlier GPT edit request that refused. Never use backup for a new text-only picture or an unknown charge.

imageUrls.description: For generate: up to ten distinct selected, reviewed HTTPS private evidence locators, in intended order. Ordinary public Library URLs cannot prove reference use.

model.description: Default photo_edit uses the native photo edit quote. GPT Image (dalle) and Nano Banana Pro are photo editors too; Nano Banana Pro is only an approved backup after a GPT edit refusal.

pictureTier.description: For generate: premium is the default; use standard only if the owner chooses it. Read the authenticated native quote for the exact account price.
